title: DRAFTSPERSON (LAND SURVEYING)
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
How many years' experience do you have as a draftsperson?
How would you rate your English language skills?
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (advert 95138941); no link out and no applications email published by the employer.
rationale: Entry draftsperson role with full in house training; little or no experience is welcome and drafting study is preferred, which Marc has (Advanced Diploma, AutoCAD).
Contour and detail survey plans in AutoCAD connect to his earthworks and road geometry drafting coursework.
Long term, office based role suits his stated strengths: attention to detail, organised and keen to keep learning.
caution: South Brisbane office only, so relocation from Melton would be needed. MAGNET software and survey instruments are not on record. Survey drafting is adjacent to his civil drafting target.
gaps: No MAGNET or survey software experience
employer_line: Steve Cooper and Associates has provided land surveying, town planning and development consulting to the South East Queensland housing industry since 1993, including contour and detail surveys and house set outs.
